items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I think Dizzy with Chano Pozo was the first real jazz musician to cross over like that.

ctx.x: But I’m talking about Latin jazz. I think Dizzy with Chano Pozo was the first real jazz musician to cross over like that. But you know a guy you should talk to is John Santos. Has his name come up?
